boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Siena study environments, ranging from library seating and rooms to academic support spaces.

cards.title: Main-Floor Tables
cards.subtitle: J. Spencer and Patricia Standish Library
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use a main-floor table for shared reading, planning, or laptop work near library services.
cards.short_summary: Open table seating for collaborative coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies main-floor tables in Standish Library as a student study location and notes library printing, copying, scanning, and borrowing services.
cards.source_title: What Saints Love About Siena's Library | Siena University
cards.access_notes: Located in Standish Library; current hours and entry requirements are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Million Dollar View
cards.subtitle: Main level, Standish Library
cards.notes: Set up on the couches by the named window when you want room for a small group discussion or a seated reading break.
cards.short_summary: Named library couch area overlooking the baseball field.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena documents the Million Dollar View on Standish Library's main level as a couch area suitable for group work and says it overlooks the baseball field.
cards.source_title: What Saints Love About Siena's Library | Siena University
cards.access_notes: On the main level of Standish Library; current hours and entry requirements are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Throughout Standish Library
cards.notes: Use a library study room for a group assignment or to spread out materials; bring a dry-erase marker for the whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed study rooms with whiteboards for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says study rooms throughout Standish Library are quiet, support group study, and include whiteboards.
cards.source_title: What Saints Love About Siena's Library | Siena University
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are throughout Standish Library; reservation rules are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Upper-Level Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Upper level, Standish Library
cards.notes: Choose the upper level for a quieter session, then use the couches facing the Quad when you need to pause between readings.
cards.short_summary: Quiet-level library seating with Quad-facing couches.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes the upper level of Standish Library as the quiet floor and identifies couches that look out onto the Quad.
cards.source_title: What Saints Love About Siena's Library | Siena University
cards.access_notes: Upper level of Standish Library; current hours and entry requirements are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Writing Center Suite
cards.subtitle: L09, lower level of Standish Library
cards.notes: Book a one-to-one session with a draft and assignment prompt to work through ideas, organization, evidence, or final revisions.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated writing-support suite with one-to-one assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena's Writing Center is in suite L09 on Standish Library's lower level and provides free one-to-one help with writing assignments.
cards.access_notes: Located in Standish Library L09; Siena directs users to make an appointment for assistance.

cards.title: Digital Scholarship Center
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Standish Library
cards.notes: Use this center when a project needs digitized primary materials; check its online collections before building a research plan.
cards.short_summary: Library center for preserving and researching digitized materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena locates the Digital Scholarship Center on Standish Library's lower level and says it digitizes documents, photographs, maps, and other research materials.
cards.source_title: Siena Opens Digital Scholarship Center | Siena University
cards.access_notes: Located on the lower level of Standish Library; current service hours and use procedures are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Fishbowl Study Space
cards.subtitle: Nobel Hall
cards.notes: Use this bright, open Nobel Hall space for individual work or a project meeting; keep shared materials compact for an easy reset.
cards.short_summary: Bright open study area for solo work or projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes Nobel Hall's Fishbowl Study Space as a bright, open area for solo work or group projects.
cards.source_title: Discover Nobel Hall: Where Learning Comes to Life | Siena University
cards.access_notes: In Nobel Hall; current building access and hours are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Meditation Room Reset
cards.subtitle: Nobel Hall
cards.notes: Take a short quiet reset here before returning to focused work, especially between classes or after an extended study block.
cards.short_summary: Quiet Nobel Hall room intended for recharging.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies a Meditation Room in Nobel Hall and describes it as a quiet retreat to recharge between classes.
cards.source_title: Discover Nobel Hall: Where Learning Comes to Life | Siena University
cards.access_notes: In Nobel Hall; use it as a quiet recharge space rather than a guaranteed reservable study room. Current access details are not stated.

cards.title: Social & Collaboration Areas
cards.subtitle: Nobel Hall
cards.notes: Meet here to compare notes, map project tasks, or rehearse a short presentation before moving back to independent work.
cards.short_summary: Nobel Hall areas designed for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies Social & Collaboration Areas in Nobel Hall for students to connect, brainstorm, and engage in hands-on learning.
cards.source_title: Discover Nobel Hall: Where Learning Comes to Life | Siena University
cards.access_notes: In Nobel Hall; current building access, hours, and reservation rules are not stated on this source.

cards.title: Academic Success Center
cards.subtitle: Fr. Benjamin Kuhn, O.F.M. House
cards.notes: Schedule support through Navigate, or stop by during listed hours for academic guidance, study-skills help, or tutoring information.
cards.short_summary: Academic support center with peer advisors and tutoring guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena's Academic Success Center in the Fr. Benjamin Kuhn House provides academic assistance and tutoring support, with trained peer advisors available for study-skills help.
cards.access_notes: Fr. Benjamin Kuhn, O.F.M. House; Siena lists Monday–Friday hours of 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Staff may not always be available for walk-ins, so appointments are recommended.
